derivation_notes: The parent assumed attenuation acts instantaneously from current occupancy alone. Here occupancy first creates a secondary burden through a saturating generation law, and that burden relaxes on its own timescale; choosing delayed_burden(0)=0 gives a non-degenerate initially unexpressed memory branch that activates only after occupancy accumulates, consistent with a delayed damage or deterioration process.
change_summary: I replaced the single-phase instantaneous attenuation by a delayed burden state driven by occupancy. This adds history dependence to dp_dt itself, producing weaker early suppression and stronger later suppression under the same current occupancy when burden has had time to accumulate.

assumption_audit.released_assumption: Attenuation responds without memory: the realized viability advantage at time t depends only on the current attenuation_occupancy, not on a lagged accumulated burden generated by past occupancy.
assumption_audit.mechanism: Favored carriers can generate a secondary burden such as toxin accumulation, physiological wear, or local habitat deterioration that integrates occupancy over time and attenuates selection with delay.
assumption_audit.parent_reduction: The successor reduces toward the parent when burden_buildup_rate is zero, or when delayed_burden rapidly tracks attenuation_occupancy under a fast-timescale approximation with burden_half_saturation large enough that burden generation is effectively linear over the visited occupancy range.

response_change.parent_relation: The favored allele gain is the product of p(1-p), a time-relaxing selection coefficient, and a monotone attenuation factor that depends only on the current attenuation_occupancy. Thus for fixed p and selection_coefficient, increasing attenuation_occupancy always depresses dp_dt with one fixed attenuation shape.
response_change.child_relation: Replace the instantaneous attenuation law by a delayed physiological/ecological burden that builds from attenuation_occupancy and modulates realized selection after a lag. Then dp_dt at the same current p and attenuation_occupancy can differ depending on accumulated burden history, creating a two-timescale attenuation and altered curvature over time.
response_change.observable_effect: Under matched initial p and similar early occupancy buildup, the child shows an early faster rise in dp_dt followed by a later sharper slowdown once burden accumulates; the parent with one shared parameter set can only attenuate immediately with one phase and cannot reproduce both the weak early suppression and stronger delayed suppression across the same time course.

evolution_contract.activation_condition: Observable when occupancy_buildup_rate is large enough that attenuation_occupancy changes on the experimental timescale, while the added burden-relaxation timescale is not negligible relative to allele-frequency change; specifically, intermediate p away from 0 and 1 and nontrivial occupancy generation are needed so the lagged suppression can separate from immediate suppression.
evolution_contract.train_hidden_contrast: In training, the mechanism appears as mild hysteresis between rising occupancy and realized dp_dt over time; in holdout, the same delayed burden produces a more pronounced late-phase downturn after similar early trajectories, extending the same two-timescale attenuation rather than introducing a new force.
evolution_contract.continuation_path: Recover the parent law when the added burden tracks attenuation_occupancy quasi-instantly with vanishing lag or zero coupling, so attenuation again depends effectively on a single current occupancy variable.
evolution_contract.promotion_reason: A delayed attenuation effect cannot be represented by refitting the current instantaneous function of attenuation_occupancy alone; one additional state is needed to encode the accumulated burden history that changes the target mapping along observed trajectories.
evolution_contract.domain_mechanism: Delayed occupancy-generated burden with saturating buildup
evolution_contract.scientific_mechanism: Favored carriers can generate a secondary burden such as toxin accumulation, physiological wear, or local habitat deterioration that integrates occupancy over time and attenuates selection with delay.
evolution_contract.difficulty_rationale: This is harder than a coefficient correction because the target derivative now depends on a hidden dynamic burden state created by past occupancy through a finite-capacity buildup law, so identical current occupancy can map to different dp_dt values at different trajectory phases.
evolution_contract.assumption_before: The current model assumes attenuation of the viability advantage is an instantaneous function of current occupancy, omitting delayed stress, damage, or ecological deterioration that accumulates from occupancy and feeds back later on realized selection.
evolution_contract.assumption_after: Attenuation is mediated by a delayed burden state generated from occupancy through a finite-capacity buildup process and relaxed on its own timescale before suppressing realized selection.
evolution_contract.after_fragment: selection_coefficient*p*(1 - p)*(1 + asymmetry_strength*(1 - p)/(asymmetry_threshold + 1 - p))/(1 + delayed_burden/attenuation_capacity + (delayed_burden/attenuation_capacity)**2)
evolution_contract.parent_reduction: The successor reduces toward the parent when burden_buildup_rate is zero, or approximately when delayed_burden rapidly follows attenuation_occupancy so the burden-mediated attenuation collapses back to an effectively single occupancy-controlled attenuation.
evolution_contract.observable_signature: Along trajectories started from the declared initial conditions, compare early and later times that have similar attenuation_occupancy and selection_coefficient. The parent predicts nearly the same attenuation at those matched current states because dp_dt depends only on instantaneous occupancy, whereas the child predicts larger dp_dt earlier and smaller dp_dt later once delayed_burden has accumulated; this is a changed target mapping, not merely an auxiliary-state change.
evolution_contract.shortcut_blocked: Refitting all existing parent parameters still leaves a one-phase instantaneous map from current attenuation_occupancy to suppression. A single shared parent parameter set cannot create trajectory-phase-dependent attenuation at matched current occupancy, so it cannot reproduce both weak early suppression and stronger late suppression across the same admissible runs.

evolution_plan.gap_statement: The current model assumes attenuation of the viability advantage is an instantaneous function of current occupancy, omitting delayed stress, damage, or ecological deterioration that accumulates from occupancy and feeds back later on realized selection.

evolution_plan.rationale: A realistic next refinement is to relax the parent's single-phase attenuation assumption. The parent target mapping from observed states to dp_dt is instantaneous: holding p and selection_coefficient fixed, dp_dt is a one-parameter monotone function of current attenuation_occupancy with a fixed curvature. That means once current occupancy is specified, past occupancy cannot matter. In many viability-selection settings, however, crowding-like occupancy first accumulates quickly while the actual loss of viability advantage emerges after a delay because damage, waste, or local depletion must build up. Vary time along trajectories from the given initial conditions while holding the fixed parameters shared across all runs; compare early versus later portions of trajectories that reach similar attenuation_occupancy levels. The child predicts weaker suppression early and stronger suppression later at comparable current occupancy because delayed burden has not yet, or has already, accumulated. This changes the scored target mapping, not only an auxiliary trajectory, because dp_dt itself becomes history-sensitive through an added state influencing p. The contrast is admissible when occupancy generation is appreciable and observations extend long enough for delayed burden to separate from instantaneous occupancy. Limitation: if occupancy remains tiny or burden relaxes infinitely fast, the effect collapses back to the parent and may be practically unidentifiable.

scenario_text: Consider a large haploid population with two alleles at one locus, where one allele has a fixed viability advantage. Track how the favored allele frequency changes continuously over time from different initial frequencies. Mutation, migration, recombination, and random sampling are absent, so directional selection is the sole driver of change.
